BALOR is identified there as the first model. Current and recent Japanese dealer records document Iblis, VALI, AVESTER, NyanBitFuzz, BRAVE and NYANTAUR. Orobas and Burenya are retained as central-pending until stronger first-party product history is recovered. Boosters, delay and enclosure/color variants remain relationship-only.
